# agy-meme (Neko Meme Stickers) **Bidirectional reaction stickers, inline composer picker & MCP server for Google Antigravity Desktop** [English](./README.md) | [简体中文](./README.zh-CN.md) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-7C4DFF.svg)](./LICENSE) [![Zero Dependencies](https://img.shields.io/badge/Dependencies-Zero-00BFA5.svg)](#architecture) [![Antigravity Desktop](https://img.shields.io/badge/Antigravity-Desktop_Plugin-FF4081.svg)](#installation)
`agy-meme` gives your AI assistant expressive reaction stickers inside **Antigravity Desktop** chat bubbles — while staying completely silent in terminal / CLI sessions (`agy`, `agycli`, IDE, ACP). It bundles 48 universal, zero-text, 100% style-consistent RGBA die-cut purple-blue heterochromia neko WebP stickers (`gemini-neko` v2.2 — universally understood across all languages with bilingual search & `scene` semantic routing) across 6 moods (`happy`, `angry`, `sad`, `shy`, `confused`, `daily`) and works **both standalone on vanilla English Antigravity Desktop and stacked cleanly on top of [`agy-desktop-exo`](https://github.com/jiangnanquan/agy-desktop-exo) / [`antigravity-desktop-cn`](https://github.com/Silas-02/antigravity-desktop-cn)**.

--- ## Features - **Bidirectional Bubble Rendering**: - AI responses containing `[表情: 描述]` automatically render as crisp inline sticker cards (default 148px with click-to-lightbox zoom, right-click actions, and toggleable/clean mode). - User messages sent with stickers also render cleanly inside `[data-testid="user-message-bubble"]`. - **Inline Composer Sticker Picker (`Cmd+Shift+M` / `Ctrl+Shift+M`)**: - Mood tabs (`happy`, `angry`, `sad`, `shy`, `confused`, `daily`), keyword search, recently used strip, click-to-insert vs click-to-send toggle, and one-click custom local image import. - **Native MCP Server (`server.mjs`, zero npm dependencies)**: - Tools: `send_meme`, `meme_list`, `learn_meme`, `meme_update`. - Reads `~/.gemini/meme-packs/` (seeded automatically from the bundled `packs/gemini-neko/` pack on first launch via copy-on-write, so your custom stickers survive plugin upgrades). - **Strict CLI Isolation (`Desktop` vs `CLI`)**: - Host process detection checks `PLUGIN_DATA` + process tree (`/bin/ps` on POSIX) so `send_meme` / `meme_list` refuse to run in `agy` CLI / IDE / ACP hosts, and `rules/AGENTS.md` enforces the same host gate on the prompt side. - **Non-Destructive ASAR Overlay**: - `./install.sh` layers only the marked Meme IPC + Renderer blocks onto Antigravity's `app.asar` (works on vanilla English Antigravity OR on top of localized `antigravity-desktop-cn`). - `./uninstall.sh` cleanly strips only the Meme blocks without removing Chinese localization or other tweaks. - **Settings UI Card**: - Automatically mounts sticker controls inside **Settings -> Appearance** (or **Chat Width** / **设置 -> 外观 -> 聊天宽度**), supporting enable toggle, auto-send vs insert mode, compact sticker size, and pack refresh. --- ## Architecture ```text agy-meme/ ├── plugin.json # Antigravity plugin manifest ├── mcp_config.json # Portable stdio MCP launch config (${PLUGIN_ROOT}) ├── server.mjs # Zero-dependency Node.js ESM MCP server ├── assets/logo.svg # Plugin icon (1:1 heterochromia neko emblem) ├── rules/AGENTS.md # Desktop host gate & sticker collaboration rules ├── skills/agy-meme/SKILL.md # Slash / agent skill instructions ├── packs/gemini-neko/ # 48 universal text-free RGBA die-cut WebP stickers + memes.json ├── scripts/meme_patcher.js # Cross-platform Electron ASAR overlay patcher ├── install.sh / install.ps1 # One-command installer (macOS / Linux / Windows) └── uninstall.sh # Non-destructive uninstaller ``` Two complementary layers work together: 1. **Standard Antigravity Plugin (`plugin.json` + `server.mjs` + `rules/` + `skills/`)**: gives the agent `send_meme` / `meme_list` / `learn_meme` / `meme_update` MCP tools and Desktop-only prompt rules. 2. **Electron ASAR Renderer Overlay (`scripts/meme_patcher.js`)**: renders `[表情: ...]` tags as real WebP stickers inside Antigravity Desktop's chat bubbles and adds the `Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+M` composer picker (pure Node.js Electron ASAR parser + macOS ad-hoc Inside-Out re-signing, zero external binary dependencies). --- ## Requirements - **Antigravity Desktop** (macOS Apple Silicon/Intel, Windows, or Linux) - **Node.js 18+** (`node -v`) --- ## Installation > Note: Run `./install.sh` from a standalone system terminal (Terminal / iTerm2 / Ghostty / PowerShell), **not** from Antigravity Desktop's built-in terminal, so restarting Antigravity Desktop to apply the ASAR overlay does not terminate your shell mid-install. (`--plugin-only` is safe anywhere.) ### macOS / Linux ```bash git clone https://github.com/jiangnanquan/agy-meme.git cd agy-meme ./install.sh ``` Or install the plugin manifest first via the Antigravity CLI, then apply the Desktop renderer overlay: ```bash agy plugin install https://github.com/jiangnanquan/agy-meme bash ~/.gemini/config/plugins/agy-meme/install.sh ``` ### Windows (PowerShell) ```powershell git clone https://github.com/jiangnanquan/agy-meme.git cd agy-meme .\install.ps1 ``` ### MCP Plugin Only (Skip ASAR Renderer Patch) ```bash ./install.sh --plugin-only ``` ### Check Status / Uninstall ```bash # Read-only status check node scripts/meme_patcher.js --status # Non-destructive strip of Meme renderer + IPC (preserves localization if stacked) ./uninstall.sh # Full removal including plugin files (add --purge-packs to also remove ~/.gemini/meme-packs) ./uninstall.sh --purge-plugin ``` --- ## Stacking With `antigravity-desktop-cn` If you also use `antigravity-desktop-cn`: 1. Install or upgrade localization first (`antigravity-desktop-cn/install.sh`). 2. Run `agy-meme/install.sh` — `meme_patcher.js` detects your localized `app.asar` and overlays only the Meme IPC and renderer blocks on top. 3. Uninstalling `agy-meme` leaves Chinese localization intact. --- ## Credits & License - Character visual design pays homage to **ZipZipPipe**'s iconic heterochromia Gemini catgirl (indexed in [`shuaizenge/ai-girls`](https://github.com/shuaizenge/ai-girls) and [`lmy414/ai-girl-stickers`](https://github.com/lmy414/ai-girl-stickers)); built-in `gemini-neko` v2.2 provides 48 unified, language-agnostic chibi die-cut stickers understood worldwide. - Released under the [MIT License](./LICENSE).

# agy-meme（Gemini 猫娘表情包插件） **专为 Google Antigravity Desktop 打造的双向表情包渲染、输入框贴纸面板与 MCP 插件** [English](./README.md) | [简体中文](./README.zh-CN.md) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-7C4DFF.svg)](./LICENSE) [![Zero Dependencies](https://img.shields.io/badge/Dependencies-Zero-00BFA5.svg)](#架构设计) [![Antigravity Desktop](https://img.shields.io/badge/Antigravity-Desktop_Plugin-FF4081.svg)](#快速安装)
`agy-meme` 让 AI 助手在 **Antigravity Desktop** 对话中用生动的紫蓝异色瞳猫娘表情包与你互动——同时在终端 / CLI 会话（`agy`、`agycli`、IDE、ACP）中**自动静默隔离**，绝不向终端吐出无法渲染的 `[表情: ...]` 文本标签。 内置 48 张全球零语言障碍、画风 100% 统一的高清透明模切 `gemini-neko` v2.2 WebP 表情贴纸（全套纯动作与视觉符号传情、零文字窄梗束缚，支持中英双语检索与 `scene` 画面实况语义路由，覆盖 `happy` / `angry` / `sad` / `shy` / `confused` / `daily` 六大情绪），既可**独立安装在英文原版 Antigravity Desktop**，也可**无损叠加在 [`agy-desktop-exo`](https://github.com/jiangnanquan/agy-desktop-exo) / [`antigravity-desktop-cn`](https://github.com/Silas-02/antigravity-desktop-cn) 中文增强汉化版之上**。

--- ## 核心特性 - **双向聊天气泡渲染**： - AI 回复中的 `[表情: 描述]` 自动渲染为高清 WebP 贴纸卡片（支持点击灯箱大图放大、右键操作）。 - 用户通过面板发送的表情也会在 `[data-testid="user-message-bubble"]` 气泡中正确渲染。 - **输入框猫娘表情面板（快捷键 `Cmd+Shift+M` / `Ctrl+Shift+M`）**： - 支持情绪分组切换、关键词搜索、最近使用记录、点选即发 / 点选插入双模式，以及一键从本地导入自定义图片扩充图库。 - **零外部依赖原生 MCP 服务（`server.mjs`）**： - 提供 `send_meme`、`meme_list`、`learn_meme`、`meme_update` 四个 MCP 工具。 - 图库采用写时复制（Copy-on-Write）设计：首次启动自动将随插件分发的 `packs/gemini-neko/` 初始化到 `~/.gemini/meme-packs/`，后续插件升级不会覆盖你的自定义贴纸与描述微调。 - **严格区分桌面端与 CLI（环境门禁双保险）**： - 服务端通过宿主进程探测（`PLUGIN_DATA` + POSIX 进程树追溯）识别 `agy` CLI / IDE / ACP 会话并自动拒绝调用； - `rules/AGENTS.md` 同步约束 Agent 在非桌面端完全静默隔离。 - **无损 ASAR 叠加注入与剥离**： - `./install.sh` 仅以标记块形式将 Meme 渲染器与 IPC 叠加到当前 `app.asar`； - `./uninstall.sh` 仅精准剥离 Meme 标记块，完好保留 `antigravity-desktop-cn` 的中文汉化与扩展增强。 - **设置面板原生集成**： - 自动挂载到 **设置 → 外观 → 聊天宽度**（英文原版挂载于 **Settings → Appearance → Chat Width**）设置卡片，可随时开关贴纸渲染、切换点击直发与小图模式。 --- ## 架构设计 ```text agy-meme/ ├── plugin.json # Antigravity 插件清单 ├── mcp_config.json # 可移植 stdio MCP 启动配置（${PLUGIN_ROOT}） ├── server.mjs # 零依赖 Node.js ESM MCP 服务 ├── assets/logo.svg # 插件图标（1:1 异色瞳猫娘徽标） ├── rules/AGENTS.md # 桌面端门禁与表情包协作规范 ├── skills/agy-meme/SKILL.md # 技能说明与使用指引 ├── packs/gemini-neko/ # 48 张全统一无字透明模切 WebP 猫娘贴纸与语义索引 ├── scripts/meme_patcher.js # 跨平台 Electron ASAR 叠加补丁器（纯 Node.js） ├── install.sh / install.ps1 # 一键安装脚本（macOS / Linux / Windows） └── uninstall.sh # 无损卸载脚本 ``` 插件由两层协同工作： 1. **标准 Antigravity 插件层（`plugin.json` + `server.mjs` + `rules/` + `skills/`）**：为 Agent 注入 MCP 工具与桌面端门禁规范。 2. **桌面端 ASAR 渲染叠加层（`scripts/meme_patcher.js`）**：纯 Node.js 解析并叠加写入 `app.asar`（macOS 自动执行 Inside-Out ad-hoc 重签，零 Python/外部二进制依赖），将 `[表情: ...]` 真实渲染到客户端界面并挂载快捷键选图面板。 --- ## 环境要求 - **Antigravity Desktop**（macOS Apple Silicon / Intel、Windows 或 Linux） - **Node.js 18+**（`node -v`） --- ## 快速安装 > 提示：执行全量桌面注入 `./install.sh` 时，请在**系统独立终端**（Terminal / iTerm2 / Ghostty / PowerShell）中运行，避免在 Antigravity 内置终端重启客户端时中断当前会话；若仅同步插件与图库，可在任意终端使用 `--plugin-only`。 ### macOS / Linux ```bash git clone https://github.com/jiangnanquan/agy-meme.git cd agy-meme ./install.sh ``` 若你已通过官方 CLI 安装本插件，也可直接叠加启用桌面渲染器： ```bash agy plugin install https://github.com/jiangnanquan/agy-meme bash ~/.gemini/config/plugins/agy-meme/install.sh ``` ### Windows (PowerShell) ```powershell git clone https://github.com/jiangnanquan/agy-meme.git cd agy-meme .\install.ps1 ``` ### 仅安装 MCP 插件（不注入桌面 ASAR） ```bash ./install.sh --plugin-only ``` ### 查看状态与无损卸载 ```bash # 只读查看当前桌面端注入状态 node scripts/meme_patcher.js --status # 仅剥离 Meme 补丁（叠加汉化时完好保留中文汉化） ./uninstall.sh # 彻底卸载并删除插件目录（加 --purge-packs 可一并删除 ~/.gemini/meme-packs） ./uninstall.sh --purge-plugin ``` --- ## 与 `antigravity-desktop-cn` 叠加使用 若你同时使用 [`antigravity-desktop-cn`](https://github.com/Silas-02/antigravity-desktop-cn)： 1. 先运行汉化安装脚本（`antigravity-desktop-cn/install.sh`）。 2. 再运行 `agy-meme/install.sh`，补丁器会自动保留汉化内容并在其上叠加 Meme 渲染器。 3. 若使用 `q-zh-agent` 多端汉化中枢，执行同步后会自动在汉化之上串联叠加 `agy-meme`。 --- ## 致谢与协议 - 角色视觉致敬画师 **ZipZipPipe** 原创的紫蓝星空猫耳异色瞳 Gemini 娘设定（参见 [`shuaizenge/ai-girls`](https://github.com/shuaizenge/ai-girls) 与 [`lmy414/ai-girl-stickers`](https://github.com/lmy414/ai-girl-stickers)）；内置 `gemini-neko` v2.2 贴纸库为全套 48 张统一 Q 版无字透明模切贴纸，无语言门槛、全球通用。 - 本项目基于 [MIT License](./LICENSE) 开源发布。
